rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within threshold.
Checks that all active StatVars (1935 in input0, 227 in input1) have MaxDate >= 2023-11.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs, SUM(CASE WHEN MaxDate >= '2023-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_svs FROM stats
params.condition: active_svs >= CASE WHEN total_svs > 500 THEN 1935 ELSE 227 END

rules.description: Checks that no StatVar regresses below the oldest historical wave (2013-07).
